name: ILI9341 2.8" TFT (SPI)
description: Ilitek ILI9341 — 2.8-inch 320×240 color TFT LCD, SPI interface. Driven with TFT_eSPI + LVGL v9.

pins.name: CS
pins.notes: Chip Select — assign a free output GPIO

pins.name: RESET
pins.notes: Display reset — assign a free output GPIO

pins.name: DC
pins.notes: Data/Command select — assign a free output GPIO

pins.name: LED
pins.notes: Backlight — connect to 3.3V or PWM GPIO for brightness control. Phase 1 wires to 3.3V.

pins.name: MISO
pins.notes: Only needed if reading back from display; usually left unconnected.

notes: Configure TFT_eSPI exclusively through build_flags in platformio.ini — never edit files inside .pio/libdeps/. Required build flags: -D USER_SETUP_LOADED -D ILI9341_DRIVER -D TFT_MOSI=23 -D TFT_SCLK=18 -D TFT_CS=<pin> -D TFT_DC=<pin> -D TFT_RST=<pin> -D SPI_FREQUENCY=40000000. Use LVGL v9 API only (NOT v8). Use a partial draw buffer (~1/10 screen = 320*24*2 = ~15 KB).
